test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Bibblography.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of 'Bibblography' according to the English dictionary is '**Bibliography**'.
 
• The word 'Bibliography' means '**a list of the books and articles that a writer used when he/she was writing a particular book or article**'.
 
 
• *Example: it provides simpler and more perspicuous explanations than its rivals.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'Bibblography'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
 
• Management- the control or organization of something
 
• Enthusiasm- a strong feeling of excitement or interest in something and a desire to become involved in it.
 
• **Intelligence**- the ability to understand, learn and think.
